overview: An assignment is the transfer of the entire remaining interest in the lease from the current tenant (assignor) to a new tenant (assignee). Subletting occurs when a tenant (sublessor) leases part or all of the premises to a new tenant (subtenant) for a portion of the term, or for the whole term but under different conditions
